nodes.label: Row-Level Access Control / Restricted Public Lookup Function
nodes.rationale: The database enforces access control at the row level rather than relying solely on the app UI, and the public emergency QR lookup goes through a dedicated restricted function instead of open database access, so a stranger scanning a helmet only ever sees a minimal, deliberately limited slice of data.

nodes.label: Administrator Data Visibility Scope
nodes.rationale: Admins can see device status, live location while a rider's dashboard is open, and crash flags for monitoring/demo purposes, but intentionally have no separate view into medical details beyond what the dashboard itself needs — scoping admin visibility to operational necessity rather than full medical access.

nodes.label: Manual Account Deletion Process
nodes.rationale: Deletion is currently a manual process handled by the research team rather than a self-service control, called out as a known limitation to be addressed later — a deliberate scope cut for the prototype stage rather than an oversight.
